listing.summary: Upstream route: Linux packages; Windows route held Limits: Experimental Linux racing route; Windows crashes loading races and is explicitly unplayable; macOS not started. Upstream platforms: Linux x86-64 is primary package. Windows x86-64 preview crashes when racing and is explicitly unplayable; Wine/Proton-only testing is not native Windows evidence. macOS not started. Original data: Own SSX 3 PAL/EU original Xbox build 2003-09-19, title 4541003C, supporting English/French/German/Spanish. Installer accepts full ISO, trimmed XISO or extracted tree into game_files/. XBE SHA-1: ba876cc11ad38650eac9831b1c7f8c4dbf7c5ba9 original, or 409141774025fce02ab4743d1e669d35bb1d190e for its documented region/media-free patched form. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
